name: Slimy Baboon 11
author: Kilian-DM
description: 3d violet button that lifts and glows on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes perspective(1em) rotateX(-3deg) rotateY(3deg) translateY(-0.05em), background-color changes from #8e44ad to #9b59b6, box-shadow becomes 0 0.3em 0.6em #000000. On focus, transform becomes perspective(1em) rotateX(-3deg) rotateY(3deg) translateY(-0.05em), background-color changes from #8e44ad to #e74c3c, box-shadow becomes 0 0.3em 0.6em #000000.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Slimy Baboon 11</title>
<style>
/* Slimy Baboon 11 by Kilian-DM — https://uiverse.io/Kilian-DM/slimy-baboon-11 */
.button-3d {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 0.5em 1em;
  font-size: 1.06em;
  font-weight: bold;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #fff;
  background-color: #8e44ad;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 0.25em;
  box-shadow: 0 0.15em 0.3em rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
  transform: perspective(1em) rotateX(-1deg) rotateY(1deg);
  transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out;
}

.button-3d:hover {
  transform: perspective(1em) rotateX(-3deg) rotateY(3deg) translateY(-0.05em);
  background-color: #9b59b6;
  box-shadow: 0 0.3em 0.6em rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}

.button-3d:focus,
.button-3d:active {
  transform: perspective(1em) rotateX(-3deg) rotateY(3deg) translateY(-0.05em);
  background-color: #e74c3c;
  box-shadow: 0 0.3em 0.6em rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
  outline: none;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button-3d">button</button>

</body>
</html>
